calls.title: Growthbook <> Cyera - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Daniel Wathne, sales; Logan Bates, solutions engineer; Graham, founder) met with Cyera (Barak Loudvinovsky, full-stack team lead; Asaf Hizki, software engineer; others) to discuss replacing Cyera's internal Boolean-only feature flag solution. Key pain points included lack of user-based targeting, SDK support, edge deployment in customer environments, and FedRAMP compliance. Next steps: a 45-minute demo scheduled for Tuesday the 17th at the same time, with GrowthBook sharing self-hosting documentation and pricing follow-up.
